description: Registers a content-addressed set of admitted document_digests (bare SHA-256). A rotating series registry includes both its series and connector digests. Returns stream_connector_registry_id. Identical sets converge; starts no recorder and changes no existing subscription. Next: start_stream with this registry_id and the exact connector digest and members or series. Never infer a registry id from a document id.
name: create_stream_registry
title: Create a stream registry
